Market today: The mood is cautious. Rising 10-year Treasury yields, hitting a 19-year high, are the real driver, making growth and tech names less appealing and increasing borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.06%) and SPAL (-33.9%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying, and showing deep losses. Margin amplifies these drops, so they need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for continued upward pressure. Also, U.S.-China trade negotiations on Monday could bring volatility to your chip names.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage your leveraged losers while staying vigilant on rising rates and upcoming trade news.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming this leveraged position, down 32.06%, or respect your 200 stop. Decay and margin amplify losses.
SPAL: Review your 21.38 stop or trim this leveraged ETF, down 33.9%. These deep losses are magnified by margin.
METU: Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE at 32.78-32.75 with a stop at 32.49. Consider adding to this winning leveraged position if it dips to that level.
